w: The Brahad Gujarati Samaj of Mumbai had arranged a welcome assembly on Chopati to honor Swamishri's philanthropic services and spiritual accomplishments. The Chief Minister of Maharashtra - Shri Vilasrao Deshmukh, President of Brahad Gujarati Samaj - Shri Hemraj Shah and Speaker of Maharashtra Legislative Assembly - Shri Arun Gujarati, spoke glowingly of Swamishri's services to society. Shri Vilasrao Deshmukh and Hemraj Shah presented the Gujarat Gaurav Award to Swamishri. More than 8,500 people applauded the award presentation to Swamishri.
In the evening, Swamishri sanctified the account books during the Chopada pujan rituals and blessed the assembly. ( Detailed news report )

On Swamishri's arrival in the evening assembly, he was honoured by the Mayor of Himmatnagar Shri Lalbhai Desai, officials of the Himmatnagar City Council and many other leading representatives local organisations and dignitaries for the extensive social uplift projects Swamishri has inspired in the region. As a tribute to Swamishri's work, the Mayor declared that the road leading from the Motipura Canal to Kasia Road would now be known as 'Pramukh Swami Maharaj Marg.' Blessing the assembly, Swamishri said, "We all do many works - for oneself, relatives and others. But the most important task is that of attaining salvation for the atma, for this we practice satsang. The scriptures teach that salvation is attained when one meets God or His holy Sadhu."
To commemorate the Bicentenary of arti, Swamishri, sadhus and devotees performed mass arti.

To commemorate the 200th anniversary of the introduction of arti by Muktanand Swami, Swamishri, sadhus and devotees performed mass arti of Shri Harikrishna Maharaj after morning puja. The occasion and ritual arti evoked a divine feeling. Swamishri narrated the brief life of Shriji Maharaj and the incident of how arti was made.

At 10.55 a.m. Swamishri sanctified the BAPS Swaminarayan Vidyamandir Residential Primary School. The English Medium Primary School includes classes from K.G. First Swamishri visited the playground where he participated with the kids who were playing football, cricket, volleyball, etc. Then Swamishri sanctified all the classrooms and conducted a class, "Say Om Matru devo bhavah, Pitru devo bhavah..." After explaining its meaning Swamishri emphasized that all should study hard and increase their faith in God. Finally, Swamishri wrote a lesson for all children on the blackboard, "Study properly. Do not be lazy. Offer prayers and do bhajan regularly."
Swamishri visited the Sanstha's land in near by Salgaon. Before departing in the evening a group photo session with children was arranged.
At 6.45 p.m. Swamishri arrived at Sarupganj village where the stone work for the Akshardham project is going on. After observing the stone carvings, Swamishri blessed the craftsmen in an assembly.
Swamishri departed from Sarupganj and arrived at Pindvada at 7.20 p.m. A welcome assembly was held and Swamishri praised the effort and skill of the volunteers and craftsmen.

st.t: A Spiritual Travelogue of Pramukh Swami Maharaj - Sarupganj, 14 November 2003
w: Swamishri visits the BAPS workshops where stones are cut and carved for the Akshardham project in New Delhi and for mandir projects in Houston and Chicago. In the workshops Swamishri blessed the craftsmen and workers.

In London, a mentally challenged boy came for the darshan of Pramukh Swami Maharaj. His name was Amrut. He met Swamishri and stretched out his hand, trying to place it on Swamishri's head. He was somewhat heavily built, so even standing he could not reach Swamishri's head. He was falling just short, and Swamishri saw this. Swamishri himself bent down and said to him, "Give me your blessings." What simplicity and freedom from ego Swamishri has!! This mentally challenged child said to Swamishri in English, "Take care when you go to India, and I send my best wishes on behalf of all the sadhus. I want to hug you." Swamishri stretched out his hands, held his, and satisfied him. This mentally challenged boy, who is often a target of ridicule in society, felt fulfilled on receiving Swamishri's pure love.

8 devotees pilgrimaged by foot from Moviya. 275 balikas observed various austerities.

Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of Akshar-Purushottam Maharaj, Radha-Krishna dev and Guru parampara for BAPS hari mandirs in Sojitra, Danteli, Porda, Valasan, Bakrol, Ranoli, Badalpur and Bhadarmiya. For most of the hari mandirs mentioned the former murtis would be replaced by the newly consecrated ones.

The evening satsang assembly commenced with Viveksagar Swami’s discourse on the Harililamrut. Then the kishores performed a drama, ‘A Priceless Boon’, and a traditional dance in Swamishri’s presence. After Swamishri was honoured with garlands he blessed the assembly, “The satsang in Rajkot is wonderful. This is because Yogi Bapa had visited this city often and blessed all with spiritual knowledge and bliss. Shriji Maharaj met Sir John Malcolm here and blessed him and the people of Rajkot. Also, Shastriji Maharaj studied Sanskrit here and Yogiji Maharaj had great love for the devotees of Rajkot. Formerly we had a small mandir in Rajkot, and today we have a wonderful hall. “The youths gave a good performance due to their love for satsang. If one has wealth but no character then there is no peace in life.”
More than 12,000 devotees attended the satsang assembly.

ds.t: How to know you are pleased
w: As Mahant Swami Maharaj was going from the assembly along the path to the sadhus' residence, Atulbhai Ajmera asked, "How can we know that you are pleased?"
"There will be peace within, no question will remain," Swamishri said.

Today Satyanarayan Chaudhary, Additional Commissioner of Police, had come to meet Mahant Swami Maharaj. His friend had inspired him to come for darshan by showing him a photo of Swamishri. The amusing thing was that while showing the photo, the friend said, "Guruji is 84 years old."
And he said, "He looks only 80."
Now, after seeing him in person, he said, "No, he looks only 60!"

Today, in trying to give everyone satisfaction and benefit in the meetings, there had to be some hurry. In it a devotee named Pankajbhai Gadhiya also had to be moved along quickly. Swamishri (Mahant Swami Maharaj) did not like this. So he had him phoned and himself asked forgiveness: "You came in the line and had to pass by quickly, so we ask your forgiveness."
Pankajbhai was moved. He came specially to meet Swamishri and said, "Swami! You need not ask forgiveness. And I did have your darshan." Receiving his blessings, he took his leave.
What a guru this is! Though it was not his mistake, he asks forgiveness of his disciple!
